Subject - Nice Weather

Dear neighbor!

Just popping in real quick - thought to tell you what lovely thing my family noticed this sunny evening out the front! 

As the day turned cooler as it often can, we noticed the warm afternoon sun still peeking between gaps to bright our front walk in glorious golden light as dusk fell.

I'm sure that makes your place glow even on glooming nights, so happy for all your lovely landscaping!

Let it help light you up on your evening, as I think you do so well lighting others's up!

Kind regards, 

Sara (from up 'round corner, just a block) PS. I'm going on my way. Have the evening, you! Hope to run across some bright moments as your street! ✉ 🎋✨🌟
 

P. PSS: If I'm out in my flowered pajamma ones and need company on deck or porch - don no need to worry, just knock. ✨😊

P.S SsS.: I love your dog, by th by (and I think I heard him bellowing for me to join, lol!) ✧*:°•
